plugins.name: fdm-design
plugins.description: CAD-agnostic FDM design and part-review skills for printed parts and electronics enclosures: hard rules against six recurring failure modes (unverified 'no supports' claims, unrepairable load paths, receptacle-cut openings, unbuyable cable routes, mismatched shell joints, silent structural changes), overhang, forced-support slice, mesh and interference checks, an acceptance pipeline for existing parts, and four specialist subagents (printability, structural, integration, verification runner).
